Single.note: Explicit defaultValue in a w-72 wrapper, so it renders as a real track rather than a hairline. Value read out beside the label, filled range in bold black against a muted track.

Range.note: Two thumbs with the filled band between them, min and max captions at the ends; the range reads immediately as a band, not two unrelated handles.

Stepped.note: step=1 over 1-5 with the five marks below; the thumb lands exactly on the labelled 3.

Disabled.note: Track, range and thumb all drop together at 50% while the value stays readable, and the helper says why it is locked.
